notes.title: Early Access Major Update #2 - Coups d’État
notes.notes:
A happy Coups D'État to you!


A Coup D’état is a forceful change from the top through sudden overthrow (and a reliable way to end a revolution!) With that in mind, our latest update Coups D'État is inspired by the famous Coup of 18 Brumaire against the French Directory which paved the way for Napoleon's ascent to power. With many new additions - including the official epic conclusion of the game - we excited to push this update out!


With this update you will find the following:
Part III campaign events, battles, and THE EPIC CONCLUSION OF THE GAME!

NEW Trial instances

NEW Addition of sounds effects

Multiple bug fixes

Just a reminder: your old saves will work with the new update BUT if you want full functionality, a new start is recommended.



We would love to know any feedback you have for us around these updates and the game. Your comments & questions are always greatly appreciated by the team!



Thanks again to everyone who took the time to send feedback after the last update, including any bugs! Reminder that if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by pressing the F1 key.



Looking to meet fellow revolutionaries? We also have a Discord, come join us!  Our Discord also has a dedicated bug channel for reporting and one-on-one support.


We present to you the patch notes for v0.16.0.0-RC3, the Coups D'État update!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png"]


Patch Notes

Strategic
New features

Added a new trial feature that triggers when a party loses all of its territories

Added and fixed a ton of strategic sound effects

Added new Part III campaign events, battles, and the end of the game

Blocked building actions (e.g. Demolish, Grant) now display the reform needed to unblock them

Bug fixes

Bug fixing for regions’ flag markers

Fixed a bug that allowed the player to continue past an event battle, even if they had lost it

Fixed a bug that caused certain popup text to appear very small

Fixed a bug that was allowing accusers to vote against themselves during trials

Fixed a bug that was allowing garrison armies to take turns

Fixed a bug that was causing unit healing rates to be incorrectly displayed

Fixed a bug that was displaying Line Infantry -only armies with a single character, rather than a group

Fixed a bug that would occasionally display the wrong colossi skin when starting a new game

Various bug fixes and improvements to the National Convention flow and UI

Various UI fixes for building menus

Rebalancing

Changed Colossi construction speed, now constructing the new unit immediately, rather than after 1 turn

Removed Hospitals and Workshops due to obsolescence

Removed the Part II Lavoisier dialogue to improve pacing


Tactical
New features

Added and fixed a ton of tactical sound effects

Started adding new 3D sound effects to tactical battles

Bug fixes

Fixed a bug that caused certain tactical UI to render over the victory screen

Fixed a bug that caused the incorrect colour to be used when displaying the loss of the Surge buff in a popup

Fixed a bug that caused the unit movement arrow to clip through the ground in certain maps

Fixed a bug that was allowing enemy units to take infinite turns, causing the game to freeze

Fixed a bug that was caused when attempting to engage units that were already engaged during event battles

Fixed a bug that wasn’t allowing certain free actions to be taken when a unit’s action points were all been used up

Fixed a bug that would occasionally display selection arrows over enemy units

Fixed a long-standing bug that would occasionally display remaining movement times for a unit with negative values

Fixed an implementation that wasn’t allowing the Cavalry and Bayonet Charge actions to function properly

Refinements

Improved a Rural biome map, making it smaller and easier to play

Made Part II coup battles more difficult through improved enemy army compositions

Slightly improved tactical AI decision-making, with improvements to movement and action timing

Various improvements to tactical battle decoration assets


Global
Bug fixes

Added a fix to ensure that game sounds continue to play when the game is no longer focused

Fixed a bug that was causing certain characters’ hair to render over their hats

Fixed a small bug that caused the King’s portrait to be slightly cropped under certain circumstances

Fixed a ton of typos in dialogue

notes.title: Early Access major update #1 - King's Trial
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, happy storming of the Bastille day!

July 14, 1789 The people of Paris seized the Bastille, the royal prison and symbol of royal arbitrariness. This came after days of riots fueled by the economic crisis and the dismissal of Jacques Necker, Louis XVI's finance minister. The insurgents searched for gunpowder and ammunition. In front of the Bastille, after hours of tension and negotiations with the governor, the crowd stormed the fortress. The Bastille fell, a symbolic victory for the people of Paris. The fall of the Bastille marked the beginning of the French Revolution. This day became a symbol of the popular uprising against absolutism. A year later, on July 14, 1790, the Republic organized the Fête de la Fédération (Fédération Festival).

Developpement has been going strong on our end and with this, we present to you v0.15.2.4-RC, the King’s Trial update! In this build you will find ;
A taste of our trial system with the King’s trial (availble on the Jacobin route)

New attribute badges above selected units in the tactical combat view, featuring tooltips for easy understanding

Three new actions as well as three new attributes for each faction in tactical

Improvement of the tactical AI

Please let us know any thoughts you may have on those new and improved features. Feedbacks are greatly appreciated!

Sidenote, while old saves will still work with the new update, if you want full functionality, a new game is recommended.

Futhermore, we would like to thank everyone who took the time to report bugs. The team is grateful for your support! Reminder: if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by pressing the F1 key while in-game. Our Discord also has a dedicated bug channel for more in-depth, one-on-one support.

You can check out the patch notes for v0.15.2.4-RC2 below, as well as our updated list of known issues!

notes.title: Summer Sale & Early Access 'King's Trial' update sneak peek
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!


STEAM SUMMER SALE

The Steam summer sale is upon us, from now until July 10th, and Bonaparte is taking part with a -10% discount.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/7b65ec0b3b03e6ef3b3b03deb6bee836f2a4838c.png"]

"KING'S TRIAL" UPCOMING UPDATE

Meanwhile, the team is busy working on the upcoming "King's Trials" Early Access update that is planned to go live later this summer!

This update will introduce a new 'Trials' feature that will conclude major narrative events that are turning points in your rewriting of the revolution! The King's escape will now be concluded by a trial and the fate of the King will be decided democratically. As for votes in the National Convention, you will be able to slightly influence the trial's outcome by swaying some of the votes through diplomacy or bribery.

Here is a sneak peek of the Trial's screen in action:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/12df557930745c7748126fd42502652d023dc172.gif"]

The update will also introduce many improvements accross the board, most notably to tactical battles. We will share more about the update very soon so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Update v0.15.2.1-RC + Updated List of Known Issues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!





To ensure that your revolution is running as smooth as possible, our team has pushed a new build. You can read the patch notes for v0.15.2.1-RC below, but some of the changes that have been made include: fixes for bugs impacting narrative progression and choice, updated combat previews and general localization fixes throughout the game. A reminder that while old game saves will work with the newest version, a starting new game is always best to ensure that issues are resolved.




If you are experiencing an issue, you can report bugs in-game by pressing the F1 key while in-game. You can also report bugs on Steam or in our Discord in our dedicated bug channel





Patch Notes




Strategic
Fixed a bug that caused narrative progression issues if the King was captured during a Royalist campaign

Fixed a bug that caused the tutorial objectives to re-appear after entering and exiting the Clubs panel

Fixed a bug in dialogue that was failing to recognize the player’s narrative choice during the Bastille battle

Player-controlled garrisons now display a point action icon, similar to player-controlled field armies

Added a new row of reform icons on the strategic map to indicate which reforms are currently active while outside of the National Convention
Tactical
Fixed a bug that would occasionally zoom the camera in during combat and leave it there after combat had finished

Ensured that tactical unit gizmos no longer drift away from units and stay frozen under certain circumstances

Fixed a bug that was allowing Cavalry and Bayonet Charge actions to pass through certain ground-level obstacles

Added a few more ground type tiles in combat sequences

Fixed a bug that caused army actions to be used up when saving the game during tactical battles

Fixed a bug that was incorrectly displaying unit selection circles’ colours during the Bastille battle

Fixed a minor UI layering bug

Renamed Pistol Commandant to Commandant and Saber Commandant to Duelist

Duelists now have the Reactive attribute

Updated combat previews to display more accurate damage information when attacking units that don’t have the Reactive attribute

Added a feature to pan the camera to speakers when dialogue occurs during tactical combat

Gave all units a new Pivot action, allowing their facing direction to be swapped during their turn

Updated the lighting and rendering of Duelist, Commandant, and Infantry mechs
Global
General localization fixes for the entire game

Ensured that the speed panel is consistent between the strategic map and tactical combat

Updated ‘?’ tutorial buttons’ text and image content

Updated many UI panels to be more responsive when switching game languages

Majorly updated all parties’ starting army compositions



List of Known Issues




Languages
At 1.0 launch, the game will include Chinese(simplified), Chinese(Traditional), Japanese and Korean, but these will not be present in Early Access
Resolution
Ultrawide resolutions are not currently supported. Please switch to 16:9 through the options
Balancing

Many of the smaller pop up panels

The save/load panel

Some panels, such as the negotiation panel in the clubs, need to be aligned better

There may also be small layout/formatting issues on various panels as well
Bugs
With the scope of the game, bugs are inevitable, and while the team is rapidly fixing bugs, several open notable bugs are:

notes.title: Patch Update v0.15.0.0-RC4 + Updated List of Known Issues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our team has been working hard to address several issues and make Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution run as smooth as possible, and with that, v0.15.0.0-RC4 is now live! This build addresses several issues including a bug where officers will occasionally disappear from the game on load and tactical combat refuses to end when too many units are present on the map, resulting in the game to softlock.

A big thank you to everyone who has reported bugs to use, and a reminder that if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by pressing the F1 key while in-game. Our Discord also has a dedicated bug channel for more in-depth, one-on-one support. 

You can check out the patch notes for v0.15.0.0-RC4 below, as well as our updated list of known issues! 

Patch Notes

 Fixed unit portraits going outside their bounds on the garrison UI screen.
 Made the Retry button purple to differentiate it from Continue at the end of combat.
 Fixed tactical combat refusing to end when too many units are present on the map, softlocking the game.
 Fixed bug where officers will occasionally disappear from the game on load.

List of Known Issues

Languages

 At 1.0 launch, the game will include Chinese(simplified), Chinese(Traditional), Japanese and Korean, but these will not be present in Early Access.

Resolution

 Ultrawide resolutions are not currently supported. Please switch to 16:9 through the options.

Game Balance

 Some tactical units (Skirmishers, Dragoons) are more powerful than other units.
 Most rebel controlled regions only have two possible army compositions.
 Tactical AI units tend to be aggressive and don’t use many abilities.

Controls

 The game is currently missing a key to swap the facing direction of a tactical unit.

Dialogue

 Some of the dialogue, in particular when buildings are constructed/demolished/upgraded or units are recruited, is very repetitive and unnecessary.
 There are several typos in the dialogue that will be addressed before launch.

Visuals

 Some of the 3D visuals are still being polished, such as the houses in the combat maps.
 There are some cluttered text popups, particularly during combat sequences.

Audio

 All recruitment panels (Battalion, Colossus, and Officer)
 Many of the smaller pop up panels
 The save/load panel
 There may also be small layout/formatting issues on various panels as well
 
Bugs

 While the team is rapidly fixing bugs, several open notable bugs are:

 After completing a defensive tactical battle, the prisoner UI will be shown but the turn will continue to play out in the background.
 The first mention of a coup in the narrative happens one turn too early.
 Sometimes, the automatic zoom will zoom too closely to the ground in tactical combat.

notes.title: Update #2 - December 2024
notes.notes:
Happy end of year celebrations!

On behalf of the whole Studio Imugi team, we would like to wish you the best end of year celebrations. This has been a particularly troubled period for the game industry, and as we reflect on these past few months, we realize that we have been lucky to withstand the storm when so many of our fellow game devs have been critically impacted by the numerous layoffs. We hope that this end of year break will allow them to enjoy quality time with friends and family, and for the new year to be full of opportunities and successes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png

As part of our development process, the whole team sat down to reflect on the past months and how the game has evolved since January. Here is a brief recap of our key 2024 milestones:

GAME REVEAL:
Jongwoo, Etienne and Martin travelled all the way to Köln, Germany, to attend Gamescom and introduce Bonaparte to the gaming press. We had a pretty neat booth, and a fully packed agenda with over 80 individual meetings! Our passion for this project was definitely conveyed with many positive previews: PCGamesN defines Bonaparte as “a visionary mix of Civilization, Crusader Kings, and… Armored Core”. We couldn't agree more :3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/9f1362de8815a1e620013b4b7d7d5afc66f9218f.jpg

If you haven't already, please consider wishlisting Bonaparte and don't miss out on future news & announcements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560340/Bonaparte__A_Mechanized_Revolution/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png

STEAM NEXT FEST:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/181e720a38fbac826aee7b1275dad3ef3287f3b0.gif
We participated in the Steam Next Fest in October and crafted a custom demo for the occasion. If you haven't found the time to check it out yet, the demo is still available to play. Head over the steam page and hit that download button :)

Play the demo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png

INSIDER INITIATIVE: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/92f6d468892cab6e6ade829908a9a0e0225b8cfa.png
After engaging early this year with a tight group of strategy veteran players, we have finally kickstarted our insider initiative in November. We strongly believe that engaging with players early in the development process can help our team craft the best game we can. 

We now have monthly dev builds available to test, and dedicated Discord channels where insiders can voice their opinions, share feedback & ideas, directly with the team.

Join us & make your voice count!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png

ANNUAL DEVELOPMENT REVIEW:
The game has progressed A LOT this year, thanks to the amazing work of our (tiny) team. From visuals to gameplay features, bug fixes, balancing, narration, music & audio, here is a brief look at 2024 major developments:



 We have completed the design and visuals of our strategic map. With the help of our Historian, we have invested a lot in making sure our late 18th century map of France was as authentic as possible. As shown below, it now includes the proper regions/départements segmentation, refined visuals, and many usability improvements (to better see the control of different factions, the population support, or the location of other squads & armies). Interactions on the strategic map have also been dramatically improved, from army movement to district management.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/451a0219f3270fe00295f52724fe38b9741ff798.gif

 A lot of effort was also spent on improving our tactical battles. We have built and keep iterating on tools that allow us to create new battle arenas, and generally pushed visual quality across the board with better rendering, animations and particles, that make our arenas a lot livelier!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/9a52b9a97536cc821e8fadb1f04e3ffef6aa2755.gif

Aside from the map, the visual quality has also been pushed on the units and the attack resolutions. The animations and textures for our 2D units as well as user interface elements have been drastically improved, and we started integrating special effects, and audio cues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/f65f904a8c7e819a7e5c08fa30124b7f4fe3162a.gif

Actual tactical features were also developed and implemented, such as the morale/heat system and the various unit abilities (such as the Colossi 'intimidation', or the cavalry 'trample' charge below).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/7a100bdd3b1ab908116ce4e577e269339c3fe32e.gif

 We implemented new historical figures to the game, each with its own 2D portrait and particular political alignment, that player can interact with. As well as many new illustrations for the different game screens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/75b11bb23c87a4f2804fe9ef63f0c872565b0129.gif

 We expanded our political gameplay with the National Convention system that allows players to gain power, participating in elections and submitting reforms to be voted on. The game simulates population classes (the masses, bourgeoisie, and clergy) and player choices now directly impact political standing, and available options on the strategic map through negotiation, military actions, or propaganda.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/6db72f9b54eb8a08555bc600d07c0139b6d95a7b.gif

 And a ton of behind the scenes work to support development moving forward (such as an autosave feature, bug fixes, balancing, etc...).



The team will stay busy until we launch Bonaparte in Early Access later next year in 2025. And we have planned to add most of our narrative content, while improving our existing systems and implementing more content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/80b7549799abdd96c15547db0be559c6857ecb87.jpg
- the Studio Imugi team


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png

Thanks for checking out our annual review! Our team is excited to launch Bonaparte in Early Access later next year in 2025. Until then, we'll be busy working on improvements to the National Convention, adding new battle biomes, as well as writing and integrating new narrative content for the campaign.

Happy holidays!
